consequence.statement: On-deployed notifications will now be delivered in scenarios where sync completes without changing application health status, whereas previously they were suppressed in such cases.

assertion.statement: Argo CD now delivers on-deployed notifications when a sync operation completes without changing the application's health status.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: exposure depends on runtime behavior of notification triggers and application sync operations, which cannot be statically determined from configuration alone
